scope: Pre-event synthetic research. Separate signed-weight linear classifier on observed frozen Qwen hidden states, not Qwen fine-tuning, not the positive-policy model, not phone/NPU deployment.
normalization: Train-only per-coordinate mean and population standard deviation, std floor0.05; no validation/heldout fitting.
optimizer: Full-batch class-balanced softmax cross-entropy plus0.02 mean-square weight penalty; Adam, lr0.02,400 fixed epochs, seed20261003.
weight_initialization: All-zero weights and biases; actual updates recorded.
threshold_selection: Require zero validation unknown-to-supported false positives, maximize supported correct accepted predictions, then accepted precision, then lower probability threshold and margin. Explicit abstain-all fallback if no feasible option. No checkpoint/hyperparameter selection after heldout.
unknown_policy: Predicted unknown stays unknown; below selected probability or top2 margin abstains to unknown. Softmax confidence is not calibrated risk.
heldout_policy: Read/evaluate heldout once after immutable checkpoint and validation thresholds; no template/prompt/model/parameter tuning from result. Autoregressive comparison afterwards on same fixed heldout.
action_eval: Exact current v0.7 Java ModelCommandGate separately validates original utterance and slots. Model intent classifier is not permission/confirmation/outcome proof.
attribution: For class logit, contribution_j = standardized_feature_j * signed_weight_j, plus class bias. Sum verified. Head-only intervention can zero/remove a feature contribution; no claim of Qwen semantic coordinate meaning or full-model causal mechanism.
compute: Existing local Python/numpy CPU; fixed GGUF probe CPU4threads/context1024; no downloads, paid API or cloud jobs.
promotion: None. Root review and new independent device/generalization gates required.
